learning_units.description: Processional waist swaying in a circular formation around drummers.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms raised overhead with excitement during high-energy passages, punctuated by theatrical expressive gestures.
movement_profile.footwork: Processional walking steps alternating with light double-time jumps on the balls of the feet.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Concentric circular processional line rotating around central drummers, gradually widening as participants join.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Continuous fluid waist swaying and lateral hip oscillations synchronized with the drum pulse.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Ground-level processional steps with low-to-medium rhythmic jumps.
movement_profile.partnering: None; individual processional movement within a group circle.
movement_profile.posture: Upright yet flexible spine with relaxed hips and slightly bent knees.

signature_moves.description: Fluid lateral movement of the waist and hips in sync with drum rhythms.
signature_moves.name: Waist Sway

signature_moves.description: Light, rhythmic springing off both feet while moving in the processional circle.
signature_moves.name: Processional Hop

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stiff torso posture or abrupt, non-rhythmic jumping that breaks circular alignment.

music_profile.musical_form: Sequential additive form starting with solo trumpet, adding hocket trumpets, drums, chorus, and processional dancers.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopated interlocking hocket aerophone patterns over a steady deep drum beat.
music_profile.sound_description: A dense, interlocking texture of five single-note side-blown gourd trumpets playing rapid pentatonic hocket patterns over a heavy, layered five-drum rhythmic foundation, accompanied by call-and-response vocals and high-pitched ululations.
music_profile.vocal_style: Call-and-response with yodeling and female ululations.

basic_steps: Step into a continuous circular processional path around central musicians.
Isolate and gently sway the waist laterally in rhythm with the drum tempo.
Execute light rhythmic hops on the balls of the feet while maintaining waist movement.
Raise both hands elevated in the air during musical climaxes.
Incorporate spontaneous comic arm and upper-body gestures while moving.
teaching.formation: Circular processional line expanding around a central group of drummers.
teaching.level_notes: Requires rhythmic coordination of waist swaying while walking and hopping in a circle.
teaching.rhythm: Polyrhythmic pentatonic hocket in quadruple or triple meter over ground drum beats.
